designationHistory.indexText: the refuge meets the definition of an "urban refuge." Image Details Established in 1956, McNary NWR was created to replace wildlife habitat lost to construction of the McNary Dam downstream.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
